final_fit_policy: model and calibrator frozen strictly before holdout start; no updates during holdout
primary_comparison: logistic_calibrated minus prior daily Brier on actually-calibrated identical rows
secondary: raw minus prior on primary population; neutral/prior scores; descriptive log loss and fixed-bin calibration
success_criterion: primary mean difference < 0 and all three two-sided 95% upper bounds < 0; otherwise no robust improvement; no profitability inference
execution: daily bucket first-trade price proxy, not a fill at midnight; strict next bucket after decision, long/cash, transition-only costs, terminal liquidation
reporting: all sensitivity lengths and folds, sample exclusions and missing intervals; no winner selection or retuning after holdout
before_opening: review code/receipt and complete dependency lock; authorize one evaluation, archive holdout snapshot checksum before metrics; never alter protocol after viewing outcomes
